## 5e4fa01a0dc0

**A1 — Reproduced distribution shortcut: walls can be semantically irrelevant.** Audited generator SHA-256: `aaadd33efdb879299935d71591c624769f6f2a83f446834c921ddb2047157e46`; executed rule hash: `8b5691eeb0ce`. The source describes color-5 walls as shortest-path obstacles, but neither generation nor `self_check` requires a wall to change either path. A declared-domain draw at seed `2`, sample index `37`, difficulty `easy` passes `self_check` with no errors even though wall-aware and wall-ignored distances are both `7` for `2→3` and `3→4`; none of the 17 painted cells is adjacent to a wall. A rival that ignores every wall therefore produces exactly the same output as the actual Racket rule on this input.

Reproducer: `checks/audit/5e4fa01a0dc0/counterexample.json`; exact input: `checks/audit/5e4fa01a0dc0/input.json`; supported Racket application: `checks/audit/5e4fa01a0dc0/racket.json`; search probe: `checks/audit/5e4fa01a0dc0/find_irrelevant_walls.py`. The Racket output matches both the Python intended mirror and the wall-ignorant rival. This audit did not modify the target. Recommended target-local repair: require at least one wall to alter a shortest-path union or reject/resample wall-irrelevant scenes, then add the retained seed as a regression.
